supersedes_prior_direction: Use full per-accepted-event input-order dispatch; no collapsed Group callback contract. Accepted-event evidence replaces a proposed generic interaction count extension.

workspace.allocation: caller-owned fixed bounded arrays; no heap or Core resources
workspace.selection_owner: caller bool array; never silently mutated by group
workspace.borrowed_lifetimes: descriptors, model, strings and callbacks through synchronous group end; Button state through existing end_frame rules
workspace.request_lifetime: only synchronous callback; const index array and request must not escape
workspace.reentrancy: no concurrent group on same workspace; each child registered exactly once; callbacks may change model but not resubmit/paint group
workspace.context_lifetime: reset workspace before reusing with a newly created context
workspace.proposed_guard: store context and nonzero ordinary-frame generation; reject cross-context/cross-frame item/end

inheritance_order: copy child options including state, slots, hover, tooltip, pointer focus and custom cursor
apply explicit group size/variant overrides; non-INHERIT design size; true compact/outline enables only
existing individual positive height/font/icon overrides remain strongest
effective disabled = group disabled OR child disabled; loading remains child-local; interaction inert includes loading
selected paint and toggled semantic state from caller model; do not normalize multiple preselected single-mode values
apply segmented corner/edge masks for count > 1; count 1 preserves child shape; no equal-width rule

callback_contract.multiplicity: one handler per eligible accepted event, original event-index order across children
callback_contract.ownership: group callback replaces child click callbacks; no group callback preserves child handlers; hover callbacks unchanged
callback_contract.default_policy: SOURCE_POINTER_CALLBACKS: source mouse-only group handler behavior; keyboard activation with group handler invokes neither replaced child handler nor group request
callback_contract.opt_in_policy: ALL_ACTIVATIONS: group requests for pointer, keyboard and accessibility
callback_contract.without_group_handler: child handler receives all accepted activations independent of policy
callback_contract.controlled_events: next request uses model after preceding callback accepts or rejects
callback_contract.multiple: ascending current selected indices, then remove clicked selected or append clicked unselected
callback_contract.background: actual group target and SIZE_MAX item index, unchanged selection
callback_contract.snapshot: current submitted inert inputs validate all events; callback changes to external disabled/loading affect next frame
callback_contract.result: accepted activation and delivered callback counts; neither means model changed
callback_contract.background_eligibility: Only enabled group with installed group callback is pointer-activatable; otherwise passive collection preserves ancestor background routing

explicit_source_divergences: disabled OR composition independent of builder order, unlike pinned child/children behavior
actual background identity instead of source stale render-local last child index
opt-in all-activation policy is useful extension, not claimed source keyboard equivalence

required_core_seams.reason: pending target query and consumed slot zero cannot distinguish accepted from current-disabled/accessibility rejected events; Boolean loses multiplicity
required_core_seams.recording: one ID per existing bounded dispatch event, set only after successful semantic registration and acceptance; reset each begin
required_core_seams.query_revalidation: current enabled target, final accessibility role/scope, ordinary phase; no consumption or new activation
required_core_seams.lifecycle_query: uint64_t cui_frame_sequence(const cui_context *); zero outside ordinary submission, increments each successful begin including dt=0, skips zero
required_core_seams.ownership: coordinate after password Stage2 releases exclusive Core; no production edit yet

stages: validate all borrowed input and workspace
register collection and all final-role/final-inert child semantics; refine metadata before dispatch
scan accepted records in input order and dispatch exactly one eligible handler per event
publish final checked/value metadata for every child
paint all children using final controlled model and shared private Button tooltip/hover helper

paint.button_only_change: append and validate these painter options; reuse existing commands/adapters
paint.horizontal: outer left first corners/right last corners; all first edges and omit subsequent left
paint.vertical: outer top first corners/bottom last corners; all first edges and omit subsequent top
paint.width: resolved actual Button border width; ghost/link/text do not gain outline
paint.gap: zero segmented gap, explicit caller padding/bounds retained

proof_required: accepted evidence before/after registration; current inert/role/scope rejection; cancellation and repeats
same-child two clicks, alternating children in opposite input/array order, key/accessibility multiplicity
controlled accept/reject and final sibling semantic/pixel coherence
0/1/2/256 items; invalid IDs/enum/buffers; partial registration and lifecycle misuse
both callback policies, callback replacement, background identity
both orientations and first/interior/last separators/corners actual commands/pixels
4 legacy plus 14 design sizes, both densities, all variants, inherit/overrides
actual browser mouse/keyboard/wheel/CDP touch, disabled/loading, cancel/next click, modal/clip and ancestor scrolling

validation.declaration_block: compiled C11 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror -fsyntax-only against existing public headers
validation.runtime: no new runtime result; proposal only
